另一边，双溪村。

村子里最近出了一件怪事。

怪事发生在徐鹤鸣家的老堂屋。

临川方言里说的堂屋，跟川蜀那边说的堂屋是不一样的。

川蜀说的堂屋，其实指的大多数就是一栋住宅的“客厅”、或者正房居中的那一间，本身就跟卧室啦、厨房啦一样，指代的是房屋类型。

但临川这边，堂屋其实是一个严格的特指。

它指代的是一个家族里，专门用于祭司和摆放先人灵位的场所。

或者更精确一点，堂屋指的是“小祠堂”，跟“大祠堂”对应，指的是一条血脉流传下来后，分支血脉的祠堂。

比如老太公、即高祖的灵位是供在大祠堂里的，那曾祖、也就是太公的灵位就是供在小祠堂、即堂屋里的。

这样的功能让堂屋往往带上了几分庄严、神秘的色彩，而再结合临川农村的某些习俗，这样的“庄严”中，便又掺杂了几分恐怖、或者惊悚。

徐鹤鸣家的堂屋，其实一直就是这么一个略带恐怖的、复杂的地方。

他家人丁不旺，从太公那里传到现在就只剩下了三家十几口人。

这十几口人本来是住在堂屋所在的老宅子里的，但几年前政府上推农网改造时发现，他们的老宅子已经没有条件去改造电网了。

不能改造电网，就意味着大功率电器全部都不能用。

什么电磁炉啦、微波炉啦、电热水器啦......全都用不了。

对一个已经走向现代化的家族来说，不能敞开了用电，简直是生活中最大的障碍之一。

于是在经过几轮协商、拿了一笔政府补贴之后，一大家子人最终全部搬了出去，到村子边缘的宅基地上重新起了屋，老堂屋、连带老宅，便都荒废下来了。

----但荒废，并不意味着完全没有用途。

逢年过节，他们还是要来老堂屋上香祭司的。

另外，徐鹤鸣家有三个老人，三个老人都已经到了风烛残年的年纪，于是也都早早地预备好了棺材。

这些棺材放到哪儿呢？

总不能放在新房里吧。

所以当然就是放在老堂屋了。

荒草丛生的老堂屋里多了三口棺材，偶尔堂屋正对着的院子大门没关严的时候，路过的人一眼就能看到里面的棺材。

那场面多少还是有点吓人的----你想想，昏暗的、破旧的堂屋，腐朽的木制窗框。

房檐上悬挂着“世泽瑰珍”的匾额，字都已经掉漆了，隐隐约约看过去，反倒只剩下个“鬼”字还有几分形状。

再加上堂屋祭桌上摆放着的灵位，墙上挂的过世老人的遗像......

你就算胆子再大，能不被吓一跟头？

看到的人不免都要骂骂咧咧几句，有些好心的，也只能一边骂一边走上去，帮着把院门掩好。

----怪事就出在关门的时候。

那天晚上，村子里一个叫徐家明的汉子喝了酒回家，正好路过徐鹤鸣家的老堂屋。

堂屋的院门没关----也不知道是被风吹的、还是他家有人去了堂屋忘记关了。

总之，跟以往的“虚掩”不同，院门是大开着的。

里面很黑，但黑也有黑的好处，起码堂屋里的东西，那是一件都看不清。

徐家明平时胆子不小，心地也不坏，看着敞开的院门，便想起了村子里次日要早起上学的小孩。

如果让小孩撞见，搞不好要做几天的噩梦。

于是他就走上前去，关了院门。

那时候正是午夜，院门的门闩已经老了，发出“吱呀”的尖锐声音。

听着渗人，但到底还是自己搞出来的，并不至于吓人。

真正吓人的，是之后的声音。

仿佛是被关门的声音惊到了，徐家明清楚地听到，从徐鹤鸣家的堂屋里，传来了一连串奇怪的声音。

那声音一开始极其细微。

起初像是有人用指甲，极轻极缓地刮着木板，节奏又缓慢又诡异。

徐家明被吓了一跳，可等他屏住呼吸细听时，那声音便停了。

On the other side, Shuangxi Village.

A strange thing happened in the village recently.

A strange thing happened in the old hall of Xu Heming's house.

The main house in Linchuan dialect is different from the main house in Sichuan and Shu.

The main room mentioned in Sichuan and Shu actually mostly refers to the "living room" of a house, or the room in the middle of the main house. It is the same as the bedroom and kitchen, and refers to the type of house.

But here in Linchuan, the main room is actually a strictly specific designation.

It refers to a place in a family dedicated to priests and the placement of ancestors' spiritual tablets.

Or to be more precise, the main hall refers to the "small ancestral hall", which corresponds to the "big ancestral hall". It refers to the ancestral hall where a bloodline is passed down and branched out.

For example, the spiritual tablet of the great-grandfather, the great ancestor, is enshrined in the big ancestral hall, and the great-grandfather, the great ancestor, is enshrined in the small ancestral hall, that is, the main hall.

This kind of function often gives the main hall a somewhat solemn and mysterious color, and combined with certain customs in Linchuan rural areas, this "solemnity" is mixed with a bit of terror or horror.

The main room of Xu Heming's house has always been such a scary and complicated place.

His family is not prosperous. From the time it was passed down by the Grand Duke, there are only three families left with more than a dozen people.

These dozen or so people originally lived in the old house where the main house was located. However, when the government promoted the transformation of the rural power grid a few years ago, it was discovered that their old house no longer had the conditions to transform the power grid.

Failure to transform the power grid means that all high-power electrical appliances cannot be used.

The induction cooker, microwave oven, electric water heater...none of them can be used.

For a family that has moved towards modernization, not being able to use electricity is simply one of the biggest obstacles in life.

So after several rounds of negotiations and receiving a government subsidy, the whole family finally moved out and built new houses on the homestead on the edge of the village. The old main house and the old house were all abandoned.

----But being abandoned does not mean that it is completely useless.

During holidays, they still come to the old hall to offer incense to the priests.

In addition, there are three elderly people in Xu Heming's family. All three elderly people have reached the age of dying, so they have prepared coffins early.

Where are these coffins placed?

You can't put it in your new house.

So of course it was placed in the old main room.

There were three more coffins in the old hall overgrown with grass. Occasionally when the courtyard door facing the hall was not closed tightly, passers-by could see the coffins inside at a glance.

The scene was somewhat scary - think about it, the dark, dilapidated main room and the decayed wooden window frames.

There is a plaque reading "Shi Ze Ge Zhen" hanging on the eaves. The paint on the words has peeled off, but when you look over it vaguely, only the word "鬼" is still in shape.

In addition, there is a memorial tablet placed on the memorial table in the main room, and the portrait of the deceased old man hanging on the wall...

No matter how brave you are, can you not be frightened?

Everyone who saw it couldn't help but curse a few words. Some kind-hearted people could only curse while walking up to help cover the courtyard door.

----The strange thing happens when the door is closed.

That night, a man named Xu Jiaming in the village went home after drinking and happened to pass by the old hall of Xu Heming's house.

The courtyard door of the main room was not closed - I don't know whether it was blown by the wind or someone from his family went to the main room and forgot to close it.

In short, unlike the previous "hiding", the courtyard door is wide open.

It was very dark inside, but darkness also had its advantages. At least nothing in the main room could be seen clearly.

Xu Jiaming is usually very courageous and has a good heart. Looking at the open courtyard door, he thought of the children in the village who had to get up early to go to school the next day.

If a child bumps into it, he may have nightmares for several days.

So he stepped forward and closed the courtyard door.

It was midnight at that time, and the latch of the courtyard door was old and made a sharp "squeaking" sound.

It sounds creepy, but in the end I did it myself, so it's not scary at all.

What was really scary was the sound afterward.

As if startled by the sound of the door closing, Xu Jiaming clearly heard a series of strange sounds coming from the main room of Xu Heming's house.

The sound was extremely subtle at first.

At first it seemed like someone was scratching the wood with nails, very lightly and slowly, the rhythm was slow and weird.

Xu Jiaming was startled, but when he held his breath and listened carefully, the sound stopped.
